strategy: Use all accessible existing datasets in the task for which they provide supervision; keep source/corpus identity and original labels; use multi-task/multi-corpus learning rather than forcing incompatible labels into one label set.

training_policy.use_all_accessible: Every usable corpus contributes to at least one relevant train/validation/evaluation/robustness role. No corpus is discarded only because it is non-commercial; KLTN is academic/non-commercial.
training_policy.no_blind_concatenation: Do not flatten incompatible emotion ontologies into one label set. Preserve original labels and corpus ID; use common-label head plus corpus-specific auxiliary heads or task-specific losses.
training_policy.asr: Use Vietnamese transcript corpora for ASR training; preserve human vs pseudo transcript source. FLEURS/GigaSpeech2 official dev/test remain evaluation partitions, not training data.
training_policy.ser: Multi-corpus/multi-task learning with shared acoustic representation, corpus-specific emotion heads and a target 4-class head. Compare acoustic-only, text-only and fusion on aligned corpora. Audio-only corpora still contribute to acoustic branch.
training_policy.transcript: Prefer human transcript where available; run ASR on audio-only emotion corpora and store ASR hypothesis separately. Never treat generated ASR text as gold transcript.
training_policy.business: OneVoice supports call-level needs_attention/topic learning and workflow simulation; do not convert call-level labels into utterance emotion labels.
training_policy.quality_filtering: Quality-score, deduplicate and weight; do not delete entire lower-quality corpus. Compare raw vs filtered and corpus-balanced sampling.
training_policy.telephone_adaptation: Use telephone recordings where available and 8kHz/codec/noise/reverb augmentation on training data; retain original group IDs.
training_policy.speed: More data can improve generalization when useful and compatible, but increases training time. Inference speed is optimized separately through model size, batching, caching, quantization and serving design.
training_policy.holdouts: Every sample is assigned a declared role; no sample is silently wasted. Maintain fixed benchmark holdouts for honest evaluation; use grouped cross-validation for small corpora.
